record.original_question: Consider a 4-manifold endowed with a foliation F by surfaces. Can the foliation be perturbed to an Engel structure?

evidence.quote: Question 2.16. Consider a 4-manifold endowed with a foliation F by surfaces. Can the foliation be perturbed to an Engel structure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth, oriented 4-manifold equipped with a smooth foliation $\mathcal{F}$ of codimension 2 whose leaves are surfaces (i.e., $\mathcal{F}$ is given by an integrable rank-2 subbundle of $TM$). An Engel structure on $M$ is a smooth rank-2 distribution $\mathcal{D} \subset TM$ that is maximally non-integrable in the sense that $[\mathcal{D},\mathcal{D}]$ is a rank-3 distribution and $[[\mathcal{D},\mathcal{D}],[\mathcal{D},\mathcal{D}]] = TM$. 

Question: Does there always exist a smooth one-parameter family of rank-2 distributions $\mathcal{D}_t \subset TM$ ($t \in [0,1]$) with $\mathcal{D}_0 = T\mathcal{F}$ (the tangent distribution of the foliation) and such that $\mathcal{D}_t$ is an Engel structure on $M$ for every $t > 0$? Equivalently, can every foliation by surfaces on a 4-manifold be $C^0$-approximated (perturbed) by an Engel structure?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches return general background on Engel structures (Vogel's existence theorem, AIM problem lists, work on characteristic foliations and round handle decompositions) but no source directly establishes or refutes that every codimension-2 foliation by surfaces on a 4-manifold can be perturbed to an Engel structure. The status appears unresolved in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.title: Existence of Engel structures (Vogel)
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of Engel structures via round handle decompositions; all parallelizable 4-manifolds admit Engel structures.
status_evidence.claim: General existence of Engel structures is known, but the perturbation-of-foliation question is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: AIM problem list: Engel structures
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems list on Engel structures maintained by AIM.
status_evidence.claim: Problems on the relationship between Engel structures and foliations are listed as open research directions.
